reviews.review_description: The sales and quoting process was good. The installation seemed fine in the beginning. We were very happy initially, but we didn't know what to look for.The brackets which attach the solar panels were not installed properly. Roof tiles were left broken leaving holes and tiles were not seated properly near the brackets. They should have shaved the underside of the tiles so that they sat flush. This fault would have been glaringly evident to a professional at the time. Once I knew what to look for I was ashamed at having been conned so badly. The owner inspected it and just walked away without saying anything. Now we have to replace the roof. Solar Central are not answering calls or emails. To make matters worse, I looked at their ABN history and discovered that they have been operating with multiple trading names changing at 1-2 year intervals. They have created a second ABN for this business name and created a Discretionary Trading Trust associated with the ABN for the business I engaged for the installation.I don't know whether this company has done the same thing to other customers, but engaging Solar Central to install our system has been devastating in our case. We are not wealthy and this could break us. BUYER BEWARE. VERY AWARE. A 10-year warranty for workmanship means nothing if the business doesn't respond or exist anymore.I am bothering to provide this review because I have heard this is a common trap for unsuspecting purchasers. People don't know how to inspect their system installation. You trust that safety inspections would provide protection. I have since heard of cases of other companies corner cutting on panel installation causing serious roof damage.

I was impressed with the knowledge and advice from the sales consultant. We were booked in for Nov but had to wait till March for installation. We then were mucked around with dates, no shows and numerous calls trying to follow up. It's now Sept and although our set up is completed we are still being ghosted on a follow up on how to use our home kit & smart meter. Very disappointed, as I like to support a local business but the lack of communication I won't be recommending them.

The crew at Solar Central were phenomenal in every facet. From quotation through to completion of the install. They went out of their way, to make sure, that satisfaction was guaranteed. I would highly recommend Solar Central to anyone seeking Solar systems for either home or business.
Very happy with Solar Central from the first enquiry to the excellent communication and good quality installation.

From quote and installation of our system every team member was obliging and happy to answer our questions. We were informed at every stage of the process and installation was arranged around our requirements, the installers were helpful very professional and tidy. Many thanks to the team at Solar Central.

Solar Central were in contact within 2hours of the request for quote through Solar Quotes and quote submitted following day.Quick and efficient from quoting to installation.After installation area was left neat & clean. No rubbish.They organised everything, including the grid connection.

I approached Solar Central as they had been recommended to me by a friend.  My sales enquiry was followed up promptly and professionally by Chantal who answered all questions and helped me gain a good understanding of solar energy.  This was followed up with a site visit from Matt who gave me a high degree of confidence that the proposed equipment and installation plan would be appropriate for our needs.Once I made the decision to go with Solar Central the paperwork and rebate application was smooth and install took place within the agreed timeframe.  Despite several days of poor weather Matt and his team completed the job with no hiccups.  All of the team members on site and in the office were friendly and courteous and took the time to keep me updated on their progress.The electrical inspection took place within a week and the system is working well.

From the outset we were impressed with the knowledge of the sales contact, well done Chantel, With 3 quotes supplied of different costs, comparisons were easier to make, and deciding which system to choose, was made a lot easier.The installers arrived on time and despite poor weather, worked late on the last day to complete the instal. After completion, the worksite was cleaned and a full explanation of how to operate the system was given and a contact number if there were any further questions.Solar Quotes arranged the electrical inspection and advised the electicity provider of the instal.Overall we are very impressed by the Solar Quotes team

I am very careful who I would recommend as I am a tradie too, but I have no issue with saying I found them to be 100% professional, from their admin to all the tradies and the follow up.  Outstanding company.They responded immediately to give me a quote, they kept me updated on start time, they turned up and worked hard.Use them.

Wonderful people to deal with, from the office to the installers, they were all wonderful, helpful, truthful and competent.They were right on time with the install. I would recommend Solar Central to anybody.

There was a delay mainly due to COVID-19 in getting the solar panels but the company was very helpful in attaining what I needed to complete my job. I had great customer service from Chantal helping with the solar rebate to Andre keeping in touch with the progress of my job. The installers were very polite and completed the job within the day and I now have my solar up and running.Thanks you to Solar Central

Solar Central provided a very competitive quote and was able to install 4 days after I signed up with them. I am very happy with my system, it's performing as expected, the Solar Central team has been very professional, I highly recommend them.
Solar central were great to deal with, Chantal took care of everything for us and all the installers were great
great company to deal with, no sales talk just good advice. system works perfectly. They also did the energy efficient hot water conversion. amazing!

I can't believe how helpful, effecient and obliging Matt, Chantal and the installers were in the whole process of applying for the rebates &  installing Solar to our property.  I'm very happy with the System that we chose from the 4 options given, and would not hesitate in recommending Solar Central.  I researched Solar Central in reviews before asking for their quote so it wasn't necessary for me to get quotes from other installers.

Solar Central was very helpful and quick to respond to emails. We received installation within three weeks of signing the contracts and paying the deposit. The cost of the system represented excellent value and it was great to see that worker safety was taken very seriously on the day the system was installed.  All in all, the entire process was low fuss and friends and family have been handed a Solar Central business card so that they too can have solar installed.

Big thumbs up to Matt, Chantal and the installers as they all did a fantastic job. Chantal in the office is very responsive and answered my queries virtually instantly. Matt came onsite to check with me about the position of the panels to get the best result as well as the best position for the Inverter. The install guys were very friendly and left a perfectly clean site. Very happy with our system - it was much more cost effective than any other  system and I'm stoked about the result.

Very happy that we went with Solar Central a local Bendigo company. Matt and the boys did an excellent job on our awkward roof in a couple of days....the site was left clean after each visit. Matt was very responsive to calls and enquiries...Chantal in the office was also very helpfulI would not hesitate in recommending them to anyone at all.

What can we say, my Husband is a Vietnam Veteran & I am a Pensioner, we cannot speak highly enough of this Company, from Chantal in the Office through to Matt & the lads who installed for us.  As Bendigo locals, it is a pleasure to be able to give our Business to a local Company, & then rate that Company A++++++++++++++++++++++++++++You would never use anyone else after dealing with Solar Central.  To our surprise, the rebate scheme has now closed until July and we are so pleased that we chose to use Solar Central.  Another unnamed (local) Company gave us incorrect information, and we would have missed out on our rebate!!!!  Hope too many people didn't do this and are now out of pocket.Thanks Chantal, Matt and all at Solar Central, we will continue to recommend you & sing your praises to all and sundry.Joy & Richmond
Mat and Chantel very professional with my dealings would highly recommend to anyone interested in installing solar
Fast turn around. Good communication. Inspected in person and got on the roof.
The staff at Solar are fantastic to deal with. Nothing is too much trouble for them and they are always pleasant. I cant recommend them enough.

With regard to the quality of the components, I am not in a position to judge. I hope that the hardware is good, Solar Central matched the materials quoted by another installer and beat the price quoted by that installer. At no time did they say that the selected components installed were not a good choice, so we will live in hope that we have made a good choice. I have stated above that solar central were great to deal with and everything went as promised. We will see in due course if the system fulfills  our expectations.

We are extremely impressed with Matt and the team at Solar Central and are writing this review in appreciation of the exceptional job they did for us recently. We wanted a 13kw system on three phase power, 10kw inverter, spanning three different rooflines, and with tilts on some to maximise production, all while taking account of early morning and late afternoon shading. So, not a run of the mill installation. We value good advice, and local service, and of the three company's we spoke with, Matt was by far the most helpful in designing a system that met what we were trying to achieve. We also appreciated the opportunity to discuss some of the more complex elements of our design directly with Matt as the owner of the business, and also on the tools. When dealing with Matt, and Chantal in the office, there was no hard sales pitch, and no putting down other companies (which we did experience with another unscrupulous local company). They were able to offer a range of panels, and did not push the most expensive. We were especially keen to use the Longi 300w panels which we consider to be at a great price point for the performance.Pricing was disclosed upfront, and was very sharp compared to the competition. For a very similar system (Fronius 3 phase inverter, mid tier panels, tilts etc), the nearest competitor was just under 50% more expensive, which is a considerable amount of money on a 13KW system.  Approximate timeframe given to start our job was two weeks, and it was even completed within that time. Communication with Chantal in the office, and Matt on the job was excellent, and we were kept up to date at each stage.Matt and the boys were on site when agreed, and didnâ€™t have any problem when we asked to make a last minute adjustment to the panel configuration. The installation is to a high standard, and once done everything was left tidy. Matt stepped through the inverter setup and connectivity, and discussed next steps. A couple of days later we got a text from Matt with a thumbs up because the system made 82kw in the day.We will be recommending Matt and the team at Solar Central to everyone we know. They went above and beyond with our installation, and made the experience a very pleasant one. If you value using local tradespeople, excellent service, flexibility, on-the-job expertise, and reasonable pricing for solid products, we would highly recommend speaking with Solar Central. We are very pleased we did.

Very happy with Matt and all the team at Solar Central. Everything was explained clearly and discussed logically about best place for panels etc. The use of the app to track solar input also explained clearly and Matt helped to set that up as well. The site was left clear of any rubbish and packaging when they left, and they all seemed to work well as a team and were all friendly and approachable. Installation was all signed off without any drama and whilst we are not experts we are pleased with how it all looks. As for "back office" support Chantal was very efficient is replying to any e-mails and was also helpful with questions we had. We have only received a couple of power bills so far but can already see the benefits of solar. I have no hesitation in recommending Solar Central.

Solar Central, and in particular Chantelle and Matt are fantastic, BUT... we are still in holding mode following installation as the power supply is at 254 volts and this has sent the inverter [Fronius] off the planet..It is still not working properly after 2 weeks..Powercor take there time and have virtually told us that 254 volts is ok??  What a nonsense .. We are not confident ..Is this over voltage an issue elsewhere??  We never contemplated such a problem..Our inverter oscillates along with our power supplier.. We watch, wait and wonder..

The team at Solar Central were a breath of fresh air to deal with. Everybody from the office staff to the workers fitting the panels were friendly and professional. It was a pleasure to do business with them.

Starting with an apology for being late - there was a traffic jam in Bendigo that morning  I was impressed with the way the team went about the installation - every one to their allotted task soon got the job underway. When completed I had a explanation of the system and my questions answered  and the site was cleaned up before the team left.
Matt and his team were responsive to our enquiries and discussed all the options to make sure we got the best solution for our needs.
Very satisfied and have recommended to other people.

Matt and the team did a excellent job all round, it is so hard to find a company now a days that does exactly as promised, we had a specific time limit to install and on the day it poured down rain and was rescheduled for two days later (still within the time we needed) they cleaned up after themselves were polite and courteous, they took our individual needs into account and installed the system we needed and the system does exactly as they said it would (we are yet to pay a electricity bill since installation and have received a credit every month for the last 6)The price was marginally higher than another similar system we were quoted but from the get go you could tell this is a business that doesn't mess about and doesn't use fancy sales techniques (this was the primary reason we chose Matt) , so even if it was just a few hundred difference I was happy to pay the difference for the superior customer service and install  I honestly couldn't rate them higher .

The price for my off-the-grid system was the cheapest. Matt listened carefully to what I wanted and came up with an excellent system. Anthony the installer impressed me with his knowledge and enthusiasm for what he was doing. Highly recommended.
Called to organise an installation date and it was all finalised, on the roof and operating within ten days and the guys all cleaned up after themselves and did a 1st class job.

I've had the system installed for nearly a year now and it is faultless. The system Matt advised me to go for is, I believe, perfect for my property.  Highest quality components and system design, and very professional installation team. Also, cost was thousands cheaper than the other quotes I got for a comparable system. Very happy, thanks Matt.

Matt did a really good job at a competitive price. We already had 20  panels on a shed and I ordered a new system with 2 extra panels (to improve system performance) to be installed on our house and for connection to the second phase of our electric supply. The new panels are of a higher capacity than those originally installed. We should have got 20 panels but I thought there would be 22 panels. So as not to disappoint me Mat threw in 2 extra panels without charge which was over and above anything I expected.

Did a good job took longer than expected due to issues with panel supplies but slight up grade in panel but slightly lower total output was end result. Didnâ€™t do pre site inspection but I was okay with as I supplied photos. Overall I would recommend (already) have to other buyers. Cheers Mike
They changed dates for installation three times with no prior notice
These poor workers turned up and it was raining and miserable. They did such a great job. They had to come back to next day to finish as weather got just too bad.
Solar Central was great. They patiently answered all my questions, including when I received conflicting information from another company.
Great service and price, and it was great to support a local business. Very fast install and no hassles.

Installation was as quick as can be expected in winter in Victoria, I wasn't home for installation however was a bit disappointed by the rubbish left behind - it was the cardboard corner protectors off the panels and there were about 10 blowing around my garden. Matt & Chantal were great and always friendly and both were always extremely helpful on the phone.

I feel it was good value for money. We looked at other local suppliers but they were expensive.Everything went smoothly, we didn't have to do anything. Our first electricity bill has arrived and we are in credit.

Matt at Solar Central did a great job walking us through all of our options and we're thrilled with our new solar system!Installation went very smoothly and efficiently. The Solar Central team were very professional and got everything up and running a lot faster than we expected.I'll definitely be recommending Solar Central to all my friends and family and suggest anyone in Bendigo and surrounding regions who might be considering solar take a good look at what they have to offer!

If I had not done lots of research to determine quality and needs it would have been a disasterYour web site was very helpful but I researched on a much broader field and even so there were still problems that I did not anticipateThe power companies are as ever full of BS and self interestThere is a lot of BS in the solar industryI ultimately had 8 quotes and not one of them met all of the criteria that you suggestedI feel sorry for the poor old pensioner that just accepts the first person that comes along and offers solar, because they will without doubt get ripped off.
Have found it difficult to get quotes have tried since October 2016. Solar Central came out discussed system including hot water heater very helpful. Couldn't be happier with service.

I live in an area where partial shading was unavoidable, so pushed for a more shade tolerant system than most would use. After getting quotes from many of the local businesses and several installers from Melbourne, Matt was excellent to deal with. Not pushy like some, and happy to deal with me largely through email, he accommodated my requests for equipment Solar Central did not usually use. I thought he really went above and beyond. Price was good relative to other systems in the KW range I looked at and I was very happy with the professional install of a system that was a bit more involved than normal.

Matt is really good at what he does. He is very reliable and efficient with the installation. He is well informed and knowledgable about the best set up for the site and the process to get everything up and running. He is very good price wise. I would recommend him over the other Solar company. I'm very happy with the outcome. Thanks.
Reliable & great service. Explained in terminology I could understand, when to use major appliances for best value & showed me what  to check for on electricity bill
The sales and engineering contact (Matt) from Solar Central was genuine in his recommendations and provided additional information and effort where required.
Job was completed on time and we have not problems with the system.

The attention to our particular requirements was exceptional. The follow-up information and service has been excellent, especially as a newcomer to solar power and the new learning this entails, therefore we believe Solar Central to have been an excellent choice.

I couldn't have been happier with the price and service from Solar Central. Matt, their sales person, was attentive, efficient and very helpfulI. He followed the whole process from initial discussion, through to the installation and then after sales service. I highly recommend them.

I would like to comment on how impressed l was with Matt owner / Supplier of Solar Central. He answered  all questions to educate me on the best options to suit my needs. Was very competitive with price  professional and importantly  on time. I had a 10kw system put in installers were polite and workmanship excellent. When you spend a big amount of money and live on your own its great to feel confident that you are in excellent hands. I can't speak highly enough of this company. Can't wait to start to make some savings.Jan. Eppalock

Matt was very helpful particularly in giving info that I wasn't aware of.  He identified that I have a 3 phase switch board therefore an appropriate Inverter was installed which in turn when Tesla mark 3 battery comes out in the near future the inverter would be ready and suitable for it. He certainly was not pushy, had the latest solar panels on the market, 330 watts per panel x 24 panels, delivering 6.2 Kw, all the paper work, connections to the grid, and the substantial rebate organised, very little stress for a large job that took most of the day to install.
From the very start i was very impressed with Matt and his team. Always kept in touch throughout the whole process. Highly recommend.
Great to deal with, responded in a timely manner, informative and competitive price.

Only 2 of the contacts replied and Matt was very prompt and Cola Solar were ages getting in touch with us. Matt was given the job and the work was completed in a very short time and we were up and running. Thanks

The service from Matt and his team was great. He explained how the system works and how to make the most of the solar system once it's installed.  As l needed to replace an old electric hot water system l got Matt to install a Chromagen Heat Pump hot water system at the same time.  I am very pleased with the whole experience and would recommend them to anyone considering installing a solar system to their home.

Solar installations in Bendigo is very competitive, so it is worth getting lots of quotes, but some of the sales people get a very pushy and try to rush you to make a decision to get your business before you get a more suitable offer.  Allstar Solar is not like this, their initial quote was low, suited to our needs and sales person was not pushy. When one of the pushier sales people who initially gave a relatively high quote deliberately undercut on very similar panels with the same inverter, Allstar solar matched the price.Allstar solar is one of the smaller installers, their sales person is also an installer, and the only sales person to actually get on our roof (split level 2 storey) to confirm panel layout before quoting. Now the panels are installed they look really great on the roof, in fact looks like the house was designed to accommodate the panels, not that they panels are a retro-fitting.
It got very confusing. Two of the suppliers were quite pushy. We went with the local person, mainly through word of mouth. Been satisfied so far, installation next week
Although too early to see a difference in my energy bill, the work was professionally carried out. Excellent service and workmanship.
Very efficient and organised.  A pleasure to work with them.
This must be the nicest company I have dealt with in a long time, very good customer support, fast and efficient installation and after sales support. Thanks a lot for a pleasant experience.
Both All Star Energy and Cola Solar were equal in presentation and assistance. The decision came down to a small difference in price. I found the salesman from Mark Group to be too pushy.
A+++ Hassle free installation at a great price. The system looks good and works great. Staff were were organised, highly knowledgeable and very friendly. Great work guys, thanks a millRegards,Melissa
Workmanship was excellent, came on time and pleasant workers.Knew what they were doing and followed through after the job was finished to see that we were happy.
Willing to give as much time as required to answer all relevant queries re PV sytem  prior to installation and excellent installation by competant trades staff

The other companies were either pushy or didn't give me full quotes in the end and did not always return my emails.One of the reasons l went with AllStar was because of their customer service and replying back to my queries. They also installed my system VERY quickly and the workers were very good, polite and respectful.

First company to contact me!These guys must be the nicest I have ever come across, very helpful, efficient and quick with installation. Also helped me out with other things I needed done due to renovations and all free of charge.I certainly will use their services again when I purchase my next property. Couldn't be happier!
I received prompt replies to all my queries without any hard sell.

Allstar Energy were a very approachable company that considers all the aspects of providing the best product and outcome for price we were willing to spend. They were open to discuss options that were mentioned by us and provided technical advice as to the pros and cons of the different products on the market. We installed a 1.8kw system on the workshop and a 4.6kw system on the house.
Easy to deal with, competent and friendly staff from start to finish.
Matt was very helpful and was always keen to find out the information we requested.  System installed within three weeks of us ordering it, and all is working well. Very happy with the whole process.
Very quick service. Very good tradesman. And a quick inspection service.

Yes, I would like to say that there was a big margin of pricing between companies for the same system.Green B $14500 6 kW, True Value Solar $12300 6 kW  and AllStar Energy Solutions $8900 6 kW all for exactly the same system. AllStar did have a November discounted special on sale, which helped with the cost.
The service and advice that was provided was excellent, and it has taken me a long time of late to find this. The plumber and the electrician were excellent.

The company did what they promised and continually kept us informed. Very happy with the way they discussed the installation of the panels so that they were not imposing image on the roof.The workers were great also.End product looks good and is working. Have recommended the company to my friends.

Matt provided a prompt quote  and his team  installed our system  even earlier than expected.  the service was all very professional  and hassel free.  we cannot rate Allstar Energy Solutions highly enough!
The company were very good to work with ,not at all pushy which is good when you are pensioners.The imformation they gave was easy to understand.  Just very good service.

From the start, after I had been pushed and pulled by sales people from other suppliers, it was like a breath of fresh air when I met with Matthew Cola.Matthew quietly explained all of the advantages of Solar and why it was better for me to have a 5kw system to benefit fully from all goverrnment and power company rebates for a long period of time.The payment terms were also very attractive. The installation has given me no concern and on each day the installers were working there was no rubbish left .

Matt was great.....very efficient and reliable with his installation, with regards to contact with us, and keeping us informed as to what was going to happen. He was very efficient and we would have no problem giving him a great review on how they handle customers.Our system is up and running on time and we are wrapt with everything so far. We cannot fault anything about our choice of system and supplier. They were great. !!!!!!
